ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI marketing platform that audits and optimizes a real brand's generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI assistant visibility against competitors.
ideas.title: AuraBrand: AI Agentic GEO and Visibility Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the power of IcyPluto and focuses on the high-priority judging criteria of AI-powered marketing automation and GEO strategies.

ideas.pitch: A 3-month short-form video marketing generator that scans trending audio and competitor reels to automatically script, storyboard, and batch-produce vertical video content.
ideas.title: ReelGen: Automated Short-Form Video & Trend Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the massive operational bottleneck of scaling creator collaborations and short-form video content production over a 3-month campaign window.

ideas.pitch: An agentic marketing dashboard that analyzes niche subcultures to match real brands with hyper-targeted micro-influencers and tracks multi-channel growth experiments.
ideas.title: CommunityPulse: Growth Experiment & Micro-Influencer Matchmaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines influencer collaboration tracking with rapid growth experimentation, showing judges a complete end-to-end execution framework for the assigned brand.

ideas.pitch: A centralized marketing command center providing real-time sentiment analysis, automated ad-spend adjustments, and cross-channel performance marketing attribution.
ideas.title: BrandOmni: Unified Performance & Social Sentiment Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates sophisticated data integration and performance marketing analytics that impress judges looking for measurable ROI on brand positioning.

ideas.pitch: An automated SEO and content marketing agent that builds topic clusters, writes high-ranking blog posts, and monitors a brand's long-tail search dominance.
ideas.title: NicheRank: AI Content Marketing & SEO Authority Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an immediate, tangible asset (built-out blog content and SEO strategy) that teams can present as part of their 3-month brand execution plan.
